'''Ashla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] enrolled in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] during the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the planet [[Shili/Legends|Shili]], Ashla was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and given over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Assigned to the Mighty [[Bear Clan]], an [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Initiate Clan]] whose members were known for their bravery, Initiate Ashla received her earliest instruction from her clan leader, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

During one of the clan's daily [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] instructional courses on the [[Jedi Temple veranda|Temple's veranda]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] approached Grand Master Yoda with a question. It appeared the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple's Archives]] were incomplete and missing a [[Kamino system/Legends|system]]. One of Ashla's peers, [[J. K. Burtola/Legends|J. K. Burtola]], suggested that someone had erased the files, therefore explaining the Archives' seeming incompleteness.<ref name="AOTC" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
One common misconception is that Ashla is one and the same individual as [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. This widespread mistake came into existence because the two are of the same species and Ashla's name is not well known. [[Leland Chee]] has stated they are not the same character, and could not be as not only do their ages not match up, neither do their names or their main color of their skin or facial markings.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1755#17143245|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2008-02-18|time=1:47 PM|quote=No. The ages don't match up.}}</ref>
